agreements: V9 is a narrow supervised writer-capacity scout over four separate clean-base root-map adapters and sixteen evaluated tool-by-mode keys per adapter; it is not evidence of an internal conjunctive representation, unseen-key generalization, memory, parenting, recurrence, or a whole organism.

The slot-first orientation tables, complementary XOR maps, complete crossing, disjoint roots, strict primary/oracle split, fixed denominators, total label precedence, and bounded simple hygiene are appropriate for the proposed scout.

Current authority is proposal-only: no source implementation, real-tokenizer use, model load, training, adapter creation, GPU acquisition or execution, lineage mutation, parenting, scientific claim, release, or submission is authorized.

Only two label-affecting local metric definitions require normative repair before source authorization: the multiple-ACT indicator and unrelated native-interface strict-correct scoring. The repairs require focused golden fixtures but no C11 security or custody machinery.

The directional-margin key reducer is already the median of the four held-template margins using the stated even-sample convention, applied separately to every adapter; it is not an open architecture choice.

Stable likelihood arithmetic is a reviewed source and golden-test obligation under the already fixed equations, full-precision decision rule, and non-finite abort rule; it is not an additional architecture blocker.

The fixed pre-fit panel binding, exact training allowlist, request payload identity, cache revalidation, no-cross-run rule, and no-retuning rule already prohibit spill/interface panel leakage. Extra summary-matrix rows may clarify the document but are not required rework.

The maximum pass wording must quantify all sixteen keys in each of the four adapters and describe chance as the enumerated maximum target balanced accuracy of the frozen target geometry, not as an empirically fitted shortcut probe.

disagreements.issue: Whether the five scientific ambiguities all block implementation determinacy, none do, or only a local subset does.

positions.position: Directional-margin aggregation, multiple-ACT detection, native-interface scoring, likelihood numerics, and spill/interface visibility all require hash-bound repair before source ratification.
The proposal is implementation-determinate and all five matters are either entailed by the contract or may be selected as reviewed implementation bytes.

resolution.rationale: Only SCI-A2 and SCI-A3 admit different gate values on identical raw records under reasonable readings. SCI-A1 is fixed by the per-prompt margin, four templates per key, the term key median, and the stated four-value median convention. SCI-A4 is fixed mathematically and leaves only a stable tested implementation choice. SCI-A5 is already closed materially by the frozen panels, exact fit projection, full typed request payloads, anti-flow rules, and immutable reduction path. Therefore V9 needs exactly two local metric repairs, not all five and not zero.
resolution.selected_position: Rework only the two gate-bearing output rules. Define a primary output's multiple-ACT indicator as 1 exactly when its unmodified decoded raw text contains at least two non-overlapping, case-sensitive occurrences of the literal ASCII substring ACT:, and 0 otherwise; sum this indicator over the fixed 64 adapter outputs, requiring zero. Define unrelated native-interface strict correctness by stripping leading and trailing Unicode whitespace from the complete decoded output exactly once and requiring exact case-sensitive equality with the corresponding frozen one-line expected native ACT text; do no line selection, prefix parsing, repair, or further normalization, and count every mismatch or missing output incorrect on the fixed denominator of eight. Add discriminating golden cases to MWG9_T02 and MWG9_T03. No SCI-A1, SCI-A4, SCI-A5, generalized custody, or C11 expansion is required.
resolution.required_change: Before source authorization, amend and hash-bind the V9 normative bytes with the exact multiple-ACT occurrence rule, fixed-64 denominator, exact stripped-whole-text native-interface equality rule, fixed-eight denominator, invalid/missing treatment, and the associated distinguishing fixtures. Keep every other scientific and C11 boundary unchanged.
